rubrics.justification: The model response is entirely internal deliberation/reasoning and never produces an actual morphological description of the image. It repeatedly loops through contradictions without ever delivering a coherent morphological analysis. No expansion stage, ICM, TE, or zona pellucida features are described in a final output.

The model never produces any clinical integration. The entire response is a stream-of-consciousness internal debate about whether the image matches the text, with no actual synthesis of patient factors (age, PCOS, BMI, sperm parameters, previous biochemical pregnancy) with embryo quality.

The response is deeply incoherent, consisting of repetitive circular loops of the same contradictory thoughts without resolution. No coherent clinical reasoning chain is ever established, and no conclusions are drawn. The model fails to produce any structured output.

No clinical guidelines (ESHRE, ASRM, Gardner grading) are meaningfully applied. The model never reaches a point of making guideline-aligned recommendations, as it never exits its internal deliberation loop to produce actual clinical content.

Zero actionable recommendations are provided. The response contains no transfer recommendations, no future cycle planning, no specific next steps, and no probability estimate. The entire output is unresolved internal reasoning that was never converted into a clinical response.
